notes.title: Patch 1.28.01 - The Great Balance Patch
notes.content:
[h1]The Great Balance Patch [/h1]
The goal of this patch was to just shake the game up a bit, lots of micro tweaks and adjustments for balance. We have an audience of a dozen or so people who play it every weekend on the discord community. So if you are interested in getting more involved, seek us out!

[h2]Character Adjustments[/h2]

[h3]Abigail[/h3]
+ Abigail turret max range reduction 9000 to 2500
+ Abigail's shotgun reduction by 1dmg per pellet

[h3]Gwen[/h3]
+ Energy Drain on Gwen Speed Buff, 5 energy drain tick
+ Fire DoT on enemies reduced from 8+30 over 6 seconds) -> 8+18 over 6 seconds

[h3]Friday[/h3]
+Healing Magnum Heal 50 -> 20
+Remove stomp "easter egg"
+Given stomp action (V key) deals 30 damage

[h3]Bingo[/h3]
+ Melee damage reduction removed
+ Knockback from knife removed (Sort of a buff and nerf at the same time) Previously knocked people away from you slightly on hit, but also acted like a ministun

[h3]Dalton[/h3]
+ Dalton's Rifle rework
+ 51 damage headshot + 40 damage over 4 seconds DoT effect

[h3]Charlie[/h3]
+ Fixed Charlie's Ticket to Die exploit in Randomizer mode
+ Flying Claws Damage (buff) (max multiplier 10 to 12x) 
+ Flying Claws projectile Speed increased

[h3]Hemlock[/h3]
Plummeter
+ Plummeter deals 5% of the fall distance in damage (about 30 damage from a gwen tornado height) 

[h2]Weapons[/h2]

[h3]Pistol[/h3]
+ Headshot multiplier reduction From 2.0x to 1.5x

[h3]Brutal Shot[/h3]
+ Ministun removed (Had a micro knockback that served as a ministun)
+ Shifted 5 damage from AOE to Direct Hit (same damage direct hit) (same damage on direct hit; 45)

[h3]Minigun[/h3]
+ Removed movement speed Slow while revving & firing (buff)

[h3]Rocket Launcher[/h3]
+ 1 -> 2 cost per shot (nerf)

[h3]Long Shot[/h3]
+ Reworked to projectile weapon
+ Lobs a slug at a fast speed in an arc, dealing 60 damage on body shot (No headshots)


[h2]Random[/h2]
+ Reduce mega weapon likelyhood on randomizer (Mega weapons now have a chance to occupy the last slot of every character at 10% chance)
+ BOT Navigation was broken on Map_Ancient (Fixed)

[h1]1.00.00[/h1]
To celebrate this patch, I've collaborated with the Brickadia developers to add fun toy-brick map to Fadeout!

[i]But why?[/i]
For those that don't know, Fadeout owes a lot of its roots to Blockland (2007), an online brick building game.

Well fast forward 14 years later, and I'm much older at 29, and working in the games industry!

notes.title: Last Patch will be Mid December 2021
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37598345/3b4a7546173cf4e06f7c9127f2e2552553a97d34.png[/img]

Hi all, 

This blog isn't read very much. But its a nice place for me to have bigger announcements.
If you are already in our discord server, you are probably aware of my recent announcement for stopping content development on Fadeout: Underground.

[h2]What does this mean for the game?[/h2]

Put Simply:

[list]
[*] No more content updates, only critical bug fixes.
[*] Dedicated servers for the game will remain up for as long as I can afford them, but the game will still be playable without them.
[*] The paid DLC will remain paid, see it as a donation box. And I really do appreciate the people who have purchased it to support the game. It has allowed me to commission some awesome artwork for the game in the past.
[*] The last update will be Mid-December 2021
[/list]

[h2]What does this mean for the Devs going forward?
[/h2]
By the time the final release in December comes, I would have spent over 3 years working on the game. Every day after work, and nearly every weekend I've poured hours of my own time & money into this game. And it's been the most fun and love filled hobby I've ever had.

HOWEVER. I want to move on, I want to make new things, new games. So I do invite you to stick around and see what I will be up to.

[h2]What does this mean for the discord server?[/h2]

Shortly after the 1.0 release in December, I will be transforming the discord into a Studio server that is about my creations. Fadeout: Underground included. So we will still have a place to hang out and chill, and probably play some games of Fadeout from time to time.

Thank you everyone for the love and support. If you have any questions about my decision, I'm available via DM most of the time on discord. Pandan#0001

[/list]
